product_family: Vizard.ai is an AI video clipping/editing tool that turns long-form video into short social clips (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts); sub-products include the web editor, a Team Workspace for collaboration, and a developer API. Note: this is a distinct company from the unrelated, similarly-named healthcare AI vendor "Viz.ai" (viz.ai) and from "Vizard.digital" and "Vizard.co" — do not conflate certifications or policies across these names.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No trust center or SOC 2 report found on vizard.ai; the vendor's own data-safety help article (help.vizard.ai) covers encryption and retention but makes no SOC 2 claim.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification on vizard.ai or help.vizard.ai.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / 27018 / 27701
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the vendor's own domain.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management system)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the vendor's own domain.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the vendor's own domain.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a HIPAA compliance program or BAA offering. Product is a consumer/creator video-clipping tool with no health-data-specific handling described anywhere on vizard.ai.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the vendor's own domain.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on the vendor's own domain; billing is presumed handled by a third-party payment processor but this is not documented on vizard.ai.

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: No dedicated GDPR compliance page was found on vizard.ai's own domain. A Privacy Policy exists at vizard.ai/policy/privacyPolicy but is a client-side-rendered page whose text could not be retrieved for direct quotation; graded held=false pending a verifiable vendor-domain quote, not because GDPR is confirmed absent.

privacy.ai_training_note: Vendor's own help center states: "We have not used, nor do we plan to use, customer data to train our models." It further states the underlying models (facial recognition, speech-to-text, screen-sharing segmentation) were trained exclusively on publicly available YouTube data. No tier-specific exception was found; this appears to be a blanket, product-wide claim rather than an enterprise-only opt-out.
privacy.data_region: US (AWS servers located in California, per vendor's data-safety article)

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.source: https://help.vizard.ai/en/articles/9629134-vizard-and-data-safety ("Your videos are securely stored on AWS servers in California, protected by the AES-256 encryption algorithm.")

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: not verified — no explicit vendor statement found

security.name: Access control
security.value: Video edit access via a temporary encrypted link, unique per user, valid for 2 hours
security.source: https://help.vizard.ai/en/articles/9629134-vizard-and-data-safety ("Access to a video for editing is facilitated through a temporary encrypted link, unique to each user and valid for two hours.")

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Free-tier videos auto-deleted 7 days after upload; deletion is permanent and unrecoverable; users can also delete immediately
security.source: https://help.vizard.ai/en/articles/9629134-vizard-and-data-safety ("Videos are automatically deleted seven days post-upload for free users... All the deleted projects are permanent from both the user's workspace and our backend and will not be able to recover.")

security.name: AI training on customer data
security.value: Not used; models trained only on public YouTube data

products.name: Vizard (web editor, free/paid consumer & creator plans)
products.data_scope: Uploaded video/audio content; free-tier auto-deleted after 7 days
products.notes: Core product. No certifications; security posture limited to AES-256 at rest and temporary encrypted access links per vendor's help center.

products.name: Vizard Team Workspace
products.data_scope: Same as core product, shared across invited team members; centralized hub for project sharing/previews
products.notes: Marketed for team/agency use; no distinct enterprise security or compliance documentation found beyond the standard data-safety article.

products.name: Vizard API
products.category: Developer API for programmatic clip generation
products.notes: No separate API-specific security or compliance documentation found on the vendor's domain.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium SaaS (free tier + paid subscription tiers; Team Workspace and API as add-ons/upsells)

flags: Identity-conflation risk: search results repeatedly surface "Viz.ai" (viz.ai), an unrelated healthcare AI company that holds SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701 certifications. These certifications belong to Viz.ai, NOT to Vizard.ai (vizard.ai), and must never be attributed to this vendor.
No trust center exists; all security claims are sourced from a single vendor help-center article, not an audited or independently verifiable compliance page.

Privacy Policy page (vizard.ai/policy/privacyPolicy) is client-side rendered and could not be fetched/quoted directly; GDPR/DPA posture could not be independently verified beyond the absence of a dedicated compliance page.

No SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or other formal certification found on the vendor's own domain — consistent with a growth-stage consumer/prosumer SaaS tool rather than an enterprise-security-audited vendor.
